layout_patterns.page_structure: A centered max-w-6xl flex container (column on mobile, row on md+). The background should use the CSS variables: background-color: var(--bg-color), background-image: var(--paper-grain).
layout_patterns.ruled_lines: CSS linear-gradient overlay to create horizontal repeating lines (var(--line-color)) and a vertical left margin line (var(--margin-color)).
layout_patterns.spiral_binding: A visual divider in the center of the two-page spread, created with absolute positioned circles or CSS gradients to mimic notebook spirals. Should be hidden on mobile (which stacks).
layout_patterns.ripped_sticky_note: A container with background-color: var(--sticky-bg), padding, slight rotation (-1deg to 2deg). Should use a jagged clip-path or an SVG jagged edge at the bottom to simulate a ripped effect. Box shadow: a slight dark blur to give it depth off the page.
layout_patterns.picochat_ui: UI elements nested ON TOP of the sticky notes or paper. Characterized by thick, imperfect black/ink borders (2px solid var(--ink-color)), square or slightly rounded corners, and the VT323 pixel font for small headers/bars. It should look like someone 'drew' a digital UI.
layout_patterns.tape: Semi-transparent white/gray rectangles with rotation positioned at corners of sticky notes or images to simulate scotch tape.
layout_patterns.bunny_ear_corner: Bottom right corner of the right page should have a CSS folded corner effect (using linear gradients) acting as a 'Next Page' or turn icon.

password_gate.layout: Full screen background image of messy desk notebook. Overlay is a ripped sticky note in the center.
elements: Password input inside the sticky note.
A small light-switch circle icon in the bottom right corner. Clicking this cycles the document.documentElement class between theme-cream, theme-pink, theme-mint, theme-lavender.
The light switch must vanish once authenticated.

disclaimer_page.layout: Centered layout on the lined notebook theme.
elements: Exact text provided in the prompt.
Clickable image button using the provided 'I Understand' cartoon character URL.

hub_navigation.layout: Drawn as doodles or large text links scattered on the left notebook page.
hub_navigation.style: Hand-drawn arrows, scribbles, and Kalam font.

drawings_gallery.left_page: Sticky note or taped image displaying the currently selected drawing (large).
drawings_gallery.right_page: Scrollable list of ripped sticky-note thumbnails. Has a search bar (drawn style) for tag/date/title.
drawings_gallery.interaction: Clicking a thumbnail updates the left page. Right-click MUST be disabled on the images (onContextMenu={e => e.preventDefault()}).

videos_gallery.interaction: Clicking opens a lightbox video player. Player must have hand-drawn UI controls for CC/play/pause/speed/skip/loop.

writings_page.layout: Blog-style entries with date/title, formatted like a two-page spread text document.

elements: 5 social slots. Empty ones show 'erased graphite pencil' placeholder styling (low opacity, smudged look).

contact_page.left_page: Approved messages board (like a guestbook of sticky notes).
contact_page.right_page: Submission form with hand-drawn input fields. Required: Name, Email, Website, How did you find this, and the 'Map' joke question.

bookmark_ribbon.layout: Persistent visual element (absolute position, hanging from top right or center) linking to the About page.

typography.h1: font-kalam text-5xl md:text-6xl text-[var(--ink-color)] leading-tight tracking-tight
typography.ui_label: font-picochat text-base md:text-lg text-[var(--ink-color)] uppercase tracking-widest

password_bg.description: Messy creative workspace with open notebook on desk (background)

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE SHADCN COMPONENTS for this site, as the prompt specifies to avoid clean SaaS looks. Build raw HTML/Tailwind components that mimic drawn elements.
Inject the Google Fonts for Kalam and VT323 into index.html.
Set up a ThemeProvider context in React that applies 'theme-cream', 'theme-pink', 'theme-mint', or 'theme-lavender' classes to the document body or main container.
Define the CSS variables for the themes in index.css as :root, .theme-pink, .theme-mint, .theme-lavender.

For the ruled lines, use a repeating-linear-gradient in CSS on the page container, e.g., background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(transparent, transparent 31px, var(--line-color) 31px, var(--line-color) 32px). Add a left margin border for the pink margin line.
Ensure right-click is disabled on drawings via onContextMenu={e => e.preventDefault()}.
Do not use generic gray/purple gradients. Everything must feel like paper, graphite, ink, or sticky notes.
